description: This file defines the BeanManager class, which manages SugarBean objects, including creation, retrieval, relationship management, and record counting within the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: BeanManager
classes.description: A class for managing SugarBean objects, handling creation, retrieval, relationships, and record counting.

methods.name: newBeanSafe
methods.description: Creates a new SugarBean instance for a given module, considering bean aliases.

methods.name: getBean
methods.description: Retrieves a SugarBean by module and optional ID, with parameters.

methods.name: getBeanSafe
methods.description: Retrieves a SugarBean safely, throwing exceptions if not found or invalid.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a BeanListRequest object for a given module.

methods.name: createRelationshipSafe
methods.description: Creates a relationship between two SugarBean objects, throwing exceptions on failure.

methods.name: deleteRelationshipSafe
methods.description: Deletes a relationship between two SugarBean objects, throwing exceptions on failure.

methods.name: getLinkedFieldName
methods.description: Retrieves the link field name between two related SugarBean objects.

methods.name: getLinkedFieldBean
methods.description: Retrieves the related bean for a given link field in a SugarBean.

methods.name: countRecords
methods.description: Counts records in a module matching a where condition.

methods.name: getDefaultFields
methods.description: Returns default field names of a SugarBean.

methods.name: filterAcceptanceFields
methods.description: Filters fields for acceptance, excluding relationship info for Person beans.
